companions._comment: Who comes on each page that has companions, before a visitor chooses: only the companions' own designs, no brands (Patrik, 2026-10-31). desktop: wide screens; phone: phones (the first one says "Customize us!" first). spots: where each starts on every visit, per desktop and phone (on: a CSS selector of the page, a heading or a box; at: 0 to 1 along it, 0.5 without). A companion only starts where its whole height fits under what is above (Ares and Artemis need about 92 px on desktop, 69 on a phone; the critters 56 to 72): one whose spot is off screen or too low starts somewhere else. The apps page names the phone picture in front (f-) or behind (b-) in the current look, as site.css shows them. looks: starting looks the visitor can change (never saved for them). scroll ride: they stay on their spot when the page scrolls, out of view with it, instead of falling (Patrik, 2026-11-01). Ids and skins: vendor/companions/companions/.
